summary_en: 500,000 shares (0.64% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired; ¥900M upper limit; open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange; execution window 15 July 2026 to 30 September 2026. Rationale: enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief: Kojima Co., Ltd. announced on 13 July 2026 that its board has resolved to acquire up to 500,000 of its own ordinary shares, representing 0.64% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury), for an aggregate expenditure not to exceed ¥900 million. Purchases will be conducted via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 15 July 2026 and 30 September 2026. The board cited shareholder return enhancement, improved capital efficiency, and the need for flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business conditions as the rationale for the program. As of 31 May 2026, the company held 382,608 treasury shares against 77,530,108 shares outstanding ex-treasury.
